description: This script manages log file backups, including moving, copying, and archiving various system and application logs based on different device configurations and support flags.

methods.name: moveFile
methods.description: Moves a file if it exists.

methods.name: moveFiles
methods.description: Moves multiple files matching a pattern from one directory to another.

methods.name: backup
methods.description: Performs backup of various log files from source to destination, with conditional handling based on device type and build type.

methods.name: crashLogsBackup
methods.description: Backs up crash-related logs such as receiver logs and crash dumps.

methods.name: backupAppBackupLogFiles
methods.description: Backs up application backup logs, handling different device configurations and support flags.

methods.name: backupSystemLogFiles
methods.description: Backs up system log files, including kernel messages, system logs, and device-specific logs.

methods.name: logCleanup
methods.description: Outputs a completion message after log backup operations.
